objective: A scan cannot be started against an application nobody has authorized
preconditions: an application with no security scope
expected: Refused as a security policy violation, naming the written authorization that is missing. The refusal has to happen here rather than in the worker: once a job carrying a target is on a queue, the decision has already been made
detail: 403: This application has no enabled security scope carrying a written authorization, so no scan can be started against it. Somebody with security:authorize has to say, in writing, that it may be tested.
